Engineered, validated, and stress-tested comprehensive testcases to cover edge cases and enforce strict Time and Space Complexity constraints (O(N log N), O(N)).

Analyzed and debugged student code submissions, providing detailed technical feedback on optimizing dynamic programming state transitions, graph traversals, and advanced data structures (Segment Tree, Fenwick Tree).
Solved and optimized over 100 algorithmic problems across VNOI, LQDOJ, and LCOJ platforms, specializing in Dynamic Programming, Graph Theory, Number Theory, and String Hashing.
Analyzed contest editorials and refactored suboptimal solution code to eliminate Time Limit Exceeded (TLE) and Memory Limit Exceeded (MLE) bottlenecks.
